title: Label
text: Label connected components in binary image, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Output data type} sets Data type of output; {Connectivity} sets the type of pixel connectivity, {Output} sets the block output Label matrix and number and {If label exceeds data type size, mark remaining regions using} sets the overflow mode of output labels maximum value of the output data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output
params.values: Block output Label matrix and number of labels (default) | Label matrix | Number of labels

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output Automatic (default) | uint8 | uint16 | uint32

params.name: If label exceeds data type size, mark remaining regions using
params.values: Overflow mode of output labels maximum value of the output data type (default) | zero
